subject.title: EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError: session GC deletes file while agent is still running

question: Should this be fixed now as a narrow cron-reaper active-admission guard, or folded into broader session/transcript lifecycle storage work?
rationale: The bug is concrete, but the durable owner boundary crosses cron retention, active session-work admissions, and session/transcript storage migration semantics.

options.title: Add active-work guard now
options.body: Update cron run-session pruning to skip or drain active admissions and add focused cron/reaper regression coverage while leaving broader storage migration for separate work.

options.title: Fold into storage lifecycle work
options.body: Keep this open as the canonical tracker and handle it inside the broader session/transcript storage migration, accepting that the active-run cleanup failure remains open until then.

options.title: Relax ambiguous pruning temporarily
options.body: Disable or lengthen ambiguous cron run-session pruning until lifecycle ownership is explicit, reducing immediate data-loss risk at the cost of retained stale state.

recommendation.title: Add active-work guard now
recommendation.body: Update cron run-session pruning to skip or drain active admissions and add focused cron/reaper regression coverage while leaving broader storage migration for separate work.
